claims.claim: Book I 'The History of a Family' is told by a local narrator
claims.evidence: 'well known in our district'; 'my hero'; narrator speaks as one of the district

claims.claim: Fyodor Pavlovitch is a lecherous buffoon, married twice, with three sons Dmitri, Ivan, Alexey
claims.evidence: 'He was married twice, and had three sons, the eldest, Dmitri... Ivan and Alexey'; chapters 'The Old Buffoon', 'The Sensualists'
the servant Grigory took charge: 'old Grigory's charge'; the sons were brought up elsewhere (second wife's affairs neglected)

claims.claim: Fyodor Pavlovitch and Dmitri both pursue Grushenka and quarrel over money and inheritance
claims.evidence: Dmitri 'in open quarrel with his father'; 'openly abandoned his betrothed for her'

claims.claim: Ivan intellectual; Alyosha a devout novice under Father Zossima
claims.evidence: 'wearing the cassock of a novice'; chapter 'Father Zossima and His Visitors'

claims.claim: Fyodor Pavlovitch is found murdered; Mitya, who had threatened him, is arrested and tried
claims.evidence: 'he threatened to murder'; trial and 'I am not guilty of my father's blood'

claims.claim: Smerdyakov, who did the deed, confesses to Ivan and hangs himself
claims.evidence: 'It was only with you, with your help, I killed him'; 'An hour ago Smerdyakov hanged himself'
'on the very eve of an attack of brain fever'

claims.claim: Mitya is found guilty and faces Siberia, with an escape planned
claims.evidence: 'Yes, guilty!'; Epilogue 'Plans For Mitya's Escape'; 'one is going to Siberia'

claims.claim: Alyosha speaks to the schoolboys at Ilusha's funeral
claims.evidence: The speech is at Ilusha's stone after the funeral: chapter 'Ilusha's Funeral. The Speech At The Stone'
claims.fix: ends the book speaking to them at Ilusha's stone after the boy's funeral

claims.claim: Smerdyakov is the Karamazovs' sullen servant
claims.evidence: Searched sullen/morose; text says 'second servant... employed as cook' and he 'mumbled... with a grin', not sullen
claims.fix: Fyodor Pavlovitch's servant, employed as cook

claims.claim: Katerina Ivanovna is Dmitri's fiancée; Zossima the elder Alyosha follows; Grushenka wanted by father and son
claims.evidence: 'surrender his betrothed to him to be rid of her, and escape to Grushenka'; 'Father Zossima' with novice Alyosha
